 Pennsylvania State Police are warning consumers about fraudulent social media ads offering home heating oil at prices well below the going rate.
 The ads direct customers to pay through cash-transfer apps. Police said scammers then use stolen credit cards to pay legitimate oil companies, leaving those businesses defrauded.
 Before placing an order, consumers should verify that the seller is legitimate and pay the delivery company directly, police advised. Be cautious of unusually low prices and requests to send payment through a third party.
 People who need help paying for home heating may be eligible for Pennsylvania’s Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, known as LIHEAP.
